itens.trecho: Sakura Uchiha ( うちはサクラ , Uchiha Sakura , née Haruno ( 春野 )) is a kunoichi of Konohagakure . When assigned to Team 7 , she quickly found herself ill-prepared for the duties of a shinobi. However, after training under the legendary Sannin Tsunade , Sakura overcomes her weaknesses and becomes recognised as one of the greatest medical-nin in the world. Following the Fourth Shinobi World War , she joined the Uchiha Clan by marrying Sasuke Uchiha . Later on, she became the Head of the Konoha Medical Department and a medical ninjutsu teacher. ↑ Rin no Sho , pages 100-105 ↑ Tō no Sho , pages 130-135 ↑ Shō no Sho , page 9 ↑ Sha no Sho , pages 136-142 ↑ Jin no Sho , pages 143-145 ↑ Retsu no Sho , pages 22-23 ↑ 7.0 7.1 Zai no Sho , page 32 ↑ Naruto chapter 71, page 7 ↑ Naruto chapter 245, page 19

He is the younger brother of Edward Elric . Al is also a victim of a failed Human Transmutation experiment to bring back his late mother, which ultimately resulted in his brother losing his left leg and right arm and Alphonse his entire body. Before it left completely, Edward managed to alchemically bind Alphonse's soul to a large suit of armour via a blood seal . Alphonse spends most of the series in this form which, while incredibly powerful and durable, is also completely unfeeling, unable to do basic things like eat, sleep, or feel a sense of touch. itens.trecho: Nagato ( 長門 ) was a shinobi of Amegakure and descendant of the Uzumaki clan . Forming Akatsuki alongside his friends (and fellow war orphans) Yahiko and Konan , Nagato dreamed of bringing peace to the violent shinobi world. However, following Yahiko's death, Nagato adopted the alias of Pain ( ペイン , Pein ) and, along with Konan, began leading the Akatsuki — an organisation that would force the world into peace using any means necessary. ↑ Sha no Sho , page 120 ↑ Sha no Sho , pages 153-157 ↑ Jin no Sho , pages 126-129 ↑ Naruto chapter 369, page 7 ↑ Naruto chapter 376, page 4 ↑ Naruto chapter 376, page 13 ↑ Naruto chapter 510, page 17
